order_comparisons.note: This is a hindsight oracle order computed from exact block dots. It demonstrates the potential value of a predictor but is not itself a deployable ordering policy.

mathematical_identity.upper_bound_for_examined_set_E: U(E) = sum_{b in E} s_b + sum_{b not in E} r_b
mathematical_identity.remaining_bound_slack: U(E) - exact_dot = sum_{b not in E} delta_b

implementation_boundary: The exact block dot is available only after reading/evaluating that payload block.
A compact sketch or learned predictor may estimate predicted_s_b for ordering only.
No predicted score or predicted slack may authorize pruning.
Pruning uses the independently conservative bound and outward-rounded arithmetic.
If the bound interval touches the threshold or tie boundary, continue exact scoring.
The deployed policy must include predictor metadata bytes, compute, cache misses and ranking overhead.
nonclaims: This is a four-coordinate synthetic example, not a measured speedup.
The exact-slack oracle order uses hindsight and is not a deployable algorithm.
The formula is a real-arithmetic identity; floating-point safety remains owned by #10918 and #10945.
